title: Going deeper: Know when the short is not enough
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Reflect, adapt and use the method independently across new settings without treating one script as universal.
pressureLine: We should be able to fix this ourselves.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
